title: Set Shot Goal Kicking (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar fiddle aussie rules football
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Now son, forty metres out, straight in front
This is what separates the men from the boys

[Verse 1]
Mark the spot where your feet need to be
Bounce it once, bounce it twice, maybe three
Eyes on the big sticks, block out the crowd
Line up the target, say it out loud

Four steps back, two steps across
Same routine every time, no coin toss
Breathe in slow, step into the kick
Drop it onto the boot, let it stick

[Pre-Chorus]
Left shoulder points the way
Right foot follows through the day
Same routine every play
Set shot, set mind, set away

[Chorus]
Set shot from forty, line it up true
Routine is the master, routine sees you through
Four steps and two, shoulders and boot
Set shot from forty, watch it sail through

[Verse 2]
The wind from the Southern End, factor it in
Two metres left of center, let the angle win
Low tee into the wind, higher when its calm
Same routine every kick, keep the method warm

[Bridge - Trevor]
Statistically speaking, set shots under pressure drop twelve percent when routine breaks
Chas: I say I say Trev, thats why we practice son

[Chorus]
Set shot from forty, line it up true
Routine is the master, routine sees you through
Four steps and two, shoulders and boot
Set shot from forty, watch it sail through

[Outro]
Now son, forty metres dead straight
Thats my boy
